newsitem.title: USA: American Home Q4 shr $0.80 vs $0.13.
newsitem.headline: American Home Q4 shr $0.80 vs $0.13.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
First Call Mean Estimate for Q4 was $0.78 per share.
First Call Mean Estimate for Year was $2.94 per share.
Full Name American Home Products Corp.

NOTES: Net income and net income per share for the 1996 fourth quarter included an after-tax gain on the sale of a majority interest in American Home of $706,279 or $1.10 per share and special charges related to the purchase of the remaining interest in Genetics Institute Inc aggregating $697,854 or $1.09 per share.
Excluding the gain on the sale and special charges from 1996 results, net income and net income per share for the 1996 fourth quarter were $503,213 and $0.79.

Net income and net income per share for the 1995 fourth quarter included after-tax special charges aggregating $308,317 or $0.49 per share for environmental liabilities related to American Cyanamid Co which was acquired in November 1994 and other items including the shutdown and discontinuance of the U.S. infant nutritional business.
Excluding the special charges from 1995 results, net income and net income per share for the 1995 fourth quarter were $389,981 and $0.62.
